comments.author: Indeterminate_Realms
comments.body:
I'm working on an AI Storytelling RPG App called "Infinite Adventure Simulator" that relies heavily on generative AI. It has a unique design and features that make it stand out against other apps like AI Dungeon. Some notable features include:

- Character stats

- Consequential player actions

- Satisfying narrative arcs

- Turn based coop multiplayer

- Unlimited ad-supported gameplay for free (no payment info required)

I've given a lot of thought to engineering the LLM to feel more like an actual game and not just a story, so I hope that comes through in the gameplay. The app is currently in open beta if anyone wants to try it:

[https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ArcticSkyGames.ChooseYourAIAdventure](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ArcticSkyGames.ChooseYourAIAdventure)
